title: Sheets are soft & Comfortable to sleep on.
text: Sheets are soft & Comfortable to sleep on.. The Sheets are too Big and Long for my King Bed as these Sheets were just King Size Sheets. Nice Sheets but a little too big and to Long for King Sheets as I have a Regular plain King Size Bed. I wanted my King Size Sheets to fit more snugly. The Pillow cases that came with the Sheets have a Pocket on each King Size Pillow Cases that dont fit my King Size Pillows Correctly. I don't like the pocket on the pillow cases. I wanted regular king Size pillow cases with no pockets on them.
